I read the relevant sections of [González-Meneses’s notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1010.0321) and [Birman–Brendle’s survey](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0409205).

The report leaves the choice to the owner: enrich BG-3 with the omitted argument, or reconcile the BG-1 seam with the BG-6 route. No item approvals or owner records were written.
